{{Hatnote|This page documents a constructed card pool. Official tournament documents remain authoritative.}}
'''Premiere &ndash; Tatooine''' (display name '''Premiere - Tatooine'''; GEMP code <code>premiere_tatooine</code>) is a constructed environment whose legal pool is the printed Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Tatooine]].

The [[2001 Brugge Belgian Open]] was played in this format (Tatooine cards are on those lists). The [[2001 Decipher World Championship]] used [[Premiere - Reflections III]], not this pool. On [https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com] the same environment is <code>premiere_tatooine</code> (set ids 1&ndash;11 plus premium/reflections ids 101&ndash;112).
